AKRES — identity (2026).

Five letters drawn as roads, in gold, running through the street grid of a city. The name and the ground it works on become one drawing: the mark reads as a word from across a room and as a map up close.

One drawing carries the system: the app icon on charcoal, the mark on paper, a single-colour version for stamps and print.

Identity design — Anirudh Kapoor. A·80.
